dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A pack of instant noodles and a can of coffee.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈpæk əv ˌɪnstənt ˈnuːdəlz ənd ə ˈkæn əv ˈkɔːfi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Instant noodles again? Have a sausage, too!
dialogue.reading: ˌɪnstənt ˈnuːdəlz əˈɡɛn? ˈhæv ə ˈsɔːsɪdʒ, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! Excuse me, how much is a sausage?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ɪkˈskjuːz miː, ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ə ˈsɔːsɪdʒ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two, please. One for my friend!
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː, ˈpliːz. ˈwʌn fər maɪ ˈfrɛnd!
